# Vengeance UI — Free Components Export
Source: https://www.vengenceui.com/components (repo: https://github.com/Ashutoshx7/VengeanceUI, MIT License)

Each folder below is a category; each .tsx file is one component's full source, exactly as published in the project's registry.

Install any single component into a Next.js/shadcn project with:
```
npx shadcn@latest add https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Ashutoshx7/VengeanceUI/main/public/r/<component-slug>.json
```
